name: getFriends
description: Returns a list of usernames of all active friends.

name: isFriend
description: Checks if a target player username or UUID is in your friends list.
parameters: username: String — Username or UUID of player.

name: getFriendCount
description: Returns the total number of accepted friends.
example:
local count = getFriendCount();
echo("Total friends: " + count);

name: getIncomingRequests
description: Returns a list of usernames of incoming pending friend requests.
returns: List<String> — List of usernames requesting friendship.

name: getOutgoingRequests
description: Returns a list of usernames of outgoing pending friend requests.
returns: List<String> — List of usernames you invited.
example:
local outgoing = getOutgoingRequests();
echo("Pending outgoing: " + arrayLength(outgoing));

name: sendFriendRequest
description: Sends a friend request to another player by username.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to invite.

name: acceptFriendRequest
description: Accepts an incoming friend request from the specified player.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to accept.

name: declineFriendRequest
description: Declines an incoming friend request from the specified player.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to decline.

name: removeFriend
description: Removes a player from your friends list.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to remove.

name: isHidden
description: Checks if the specified player is currently hidden from client rendering.

name: hidePlayer
description: Hides the specified player from your client render view.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to hide.

name: showPlayer
description: Unhides a previously hidden player in your client view.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to unhide.

name: isPremium
description: Returns true if the player account is an authenticated premium Minecraft account.
returns: Boolean — True if premium account active.
